title: U.S. House, District 17
counties: Lee (part, incl. more of Fort Myers)
what_it_does: Represents Florida's 17th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives; votes on federal laws and spending.
verified_ballot_note: Roster from WSLR (Matt Montavon wins Congressional District 17 primary; Steube unopposed in GOP primary) and Ballotpedia. No NPA or write-in candidate was identified in snippets; absence unconfirmed. Sources: https://wslr.org/matt-montavon-wins-congressional-district-17-primary/ ; https://ballotpedia.org/Florida's_17th_Congressional_District_election,_2026 ; district changes per WUSF map breakdown. Florida adopted a new congressional map (passed Apr 29, 2026, signed May 4, 2026) that reworked 21 of 28 districts; county descriptions here reflect post-redistricting reporting where found (https://www.wusf.org/politics-issues/2026-05-06/breakdown-changes-for-florida-new-congressional-map).

candidates.name: Greg Steube
candidates.photo_source: congress.gov member portrait (bioguide ID from memory, unverified)
candidates.background: Greg Steube has represented Florida's 17th District since January 2019 and previously served in the Florida House and Senate. He was unopposed in the Aug. 18, 2026 Republican primary. Under the 2026 map the district gives up inland eastern Sarasota County and takes in more of Fort Myers in Lee County.
